name: demo-kit
description: Playwright layer for recording human-watchable demo videos that double as e2e tests

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run check:package && npm run test:unit && npm run test:plain && npm run test:demo
scripts.test:plain: cross-env DEMO=false playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.ts plain.spec.ts
scripts.test:demo: cross-env DEMO=true playwright test --config tests/playwright.config.ts demo.spec.ts csp.spec.ts host-styles.spec.ts
